info.name: OpenSea Account Endpoints Drops Endpoints API
Build mint transaction data for a drop

params.name: slug
params.description: The collection slug identifying the drop

items.docs: Returns ready-to-sign transaction data for minting tokens from a drop. The caller is responsible for signing and submitting the transaction. No wallet authentication is required — only an API key. The minter address in the request body determines who will receive the tokens. Stage selection is handled automatically by the backend — if multiple stages are active, the first eligible stage is used.
Returns ready-to-sign transaction data for deploying a new NFT drop contract. The caller is responsible for signing and submitting the transaction.

params.name: type
params.description: Drop calendar type: featured, upcoming, or recently_minted

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default: 20)

params.name: chains
params.description: Comma-separated list of chains to filter by (e.g. ethereum, base). Omit to return drops on all chains.

items.docs: Get a list of NFT drops (mints) by type: featured, upcoming, or recently_minted. Results may be fewer than the requested limit due to post-fetch filtering.
Get detailed drop information for a collection, including stages and supply.

params.name: tx_hash
params.description: Transaction hash of the deployment transaction

items.docs: Check the status of a contract deployment transaction. Returns the deployment status and, on success, the deployed contract address and linked collection slug.
